extractedRequirements.title: Global E-commerce Platform Design
extractedRequirements.description: Design a robust and scalable global e-commerce platform to handle massive user base with high availability requirements.

context.consistency_model: strong consistency across user data and transactions
compliance: Payment processing regulations compliance, Data protection laws like GDPR
context.region_strategy: Global distribution with regional data centers to minimize latency
context.experience_level: Senior developers with e-commerce and distributed systems experience
context.search_complexity: Simple to moderate product search complexity

non_functional_requirements: Latency should be less than 50ms for end-to-end transaction completion.
The system must handle extreme scale with a request rate of up to 20,000 req/s and manage data volume effectively
System deployments are planned on daily basis ensuring quick iterative improvements

database.justification: For a global e-commerce platform, CockroachDB is ideal due to its ACID compliance for transactions ensuring strong consistency across user data and transactions. Its ability to keep track of timestamps allows efficient handling of eventual consistency requirements in the face of network partitions or delays.

cache.justification: Given its high availability, low latency access for read/write operations and support across multiple programming languages through various clients. Redis also provides a simple client API which simplifies integration into the e-commerce platform.

messaging.justification: Integrating with these services enables fanout messaging pattern effectively pushing messages to multiple subscribers at once, which is essential for handling massive user base and ensuring high availability. The decoupling provided by the queue service allows specific roles within distributed systems like order processing or notifications.

deployment.justification: For a global e-commerce platform, Kubernetes is essential for managing containerized applications across multiple regions and data centers. It supports horizontal scaling with no downtime which aligns well with the expected high traffic volume.

observability.justification: For monitoring continuous availability, Prometheus can be used for its ability to continuously monitor patients' conditions leading to timely treatment. This translates into real-time system health checks and performance metrics which are crucial in maintaining the SLO of 99.99% uptime per month.

security.justification: To protect against DDoS attacks and ensure high availability, AWS WAF provides a layered security approach to filter malicious traffic. AWS Shield offers additional protection with its managed detection service for potential threats.
